functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account creation process must validate 100% of required fields (name, gender, password, mobile number, location) before allowing account creation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires collecting specific personal details, necessitating complete validation of all required information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account creation process must complete within 3 seconds after submission of valid information under normal network conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Account creation is a critical entry point for users, requiring efficient processing to maintain user engagement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account creation form must provide clear error messages for all validation failures, with specific guidance on how to correct each issue.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input of personal details, requiring clear feedback to help users successfully complete the process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account creation system must maintain 99.9% uptime during peak registration periods.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Account creation is a critical entry point that must be consistently available to users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All personal details must be transmitted using TLS 1.3 encryption and stored with AES-256 encryption at rest.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves collection of sensitive personal information requiring strong security measures.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Passwords must enforce complexity requirements: minimum 8 characters, including at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Password is a critical security element mentioned in the FR that requires specific security controls.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The account creation module must be implemented as a separate service with well-defined APIs to allow for independent updates and maintenance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Account creation functionality will likely require updates as requirements evolve, necessitating a maintainable architecture.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support internationalization for all input fields, supporting at least 10 major languages and regional formats for location and phone numbers.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mentions location, suggesting global usage requiring adaptability to different regions and languages.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to import and manage various data formats like images, videos, and audio files within presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support importing at least 5 common formats for each media type: images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, SVG), videos (MP4, AVI, MOV, WMV, WEBM), and audio (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, OGG).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies handling various data formats, requiring comprehensive format support for each media type.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must import media files up to 100MB in size within 5 seconds under normal network conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Media file import is a key functionality that requires efficient processing to maintain workflow continuity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must automatically optimize imported media files to reduce presentation size by at least 30% without significant quality loss.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Managing media within presentations implies the need for resource optimization to maintain performance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Imported media must maintain compatibility with at least 3 major presentation export formats (e.g., PPTX, PDF, HTML).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves managing media within presentations, requiring interoperability with standard presentation formats.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The media import interface must provide drag-and-drop functionality and preview capabilities for all supported file types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Managing various media formats requires intuitive interfaces to enhance user experience and productivity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must gracefully handle corrupt or incompatible media files by providing clear error messages without crashing the application.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Importing various file formats introduces potential failure points that must be handled reliably.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must scan all imported media files for malware using up-to-date virus definitions before incorporating them into presentations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Importing external files presents security risks that must be mitigated to protect user systems.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The media import and management modules must use a plugin architecture allowing new format support to be added without modifying the core application.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mentions various formats which will evolve over time, requiring a maintainable approach to format support.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must allow customizable import settings for each media type, including resolution, compression level, and quality settings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Managing various media formats requires adaptability to different quality and size requirements.
